## Closing evidence — AC10 satisfied by a dispatched post-merge run

AC10 was the last open criterion and is marked `[non-codebase]` because its
evidence is a live GitHub Actions run against real Jira Data Center, not
anything readable from the tree.

### The run

`external-integration.yml` (registered as **Live External Integration**,
workflow id `296028316`) was dispatched against `main` after this ticket's fix
merged. No qualifying completed post-merge run existed beforehand — the latest
completed dispatch was `35508005436` at `e84e4c5e`, which does not contain the
merge `254d076cb50ef01bcded5e35bba09e1b6f240cc2`, so a fresh dispatch was
required rather than reusing an older run.

**Run `35534905486`**, head `ba878272701217b42fac59e4241e69eab24097fe`, event
`workflow_dispatch`.
https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/35534905486

Job `jira DC harness smoke (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)`, step
`Run the Jira DC harness smoke tests`, ran `2026-09-20T20:19:41Z` →
`2026-09-20T22:29:42Z`.

### The measurement

The defect was that the entire ~2-hour pytest step collapsed onto a single log
timestamp, so a healthy long run and a hung one were indistinguishable from the
outside. The post-merge step emits **238 distinct timestamps across 239 log
lines** — effectively one timestamp per line, which is the opposite of the
reported behaviour.

Progress is now visible as it happens:

```
2026-09-20T20:27:40.5782319Z tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[02-edit-summary] PASSED [  1%]
2026-09-20T20:30:12.1918906Z tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[03-edit-description] PASSED [  2%]
2026-09-20T20:32:47.0609990Z tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status] PASSED [  3%]
2026-09-20T20:35:20.1928779Z tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[05-add-label] PASSED [  5%]
2026-09-20T20:37:55.2142579Z tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[06-remove-label] PASSED [  6%]
```

Roughly two and a half minutes separate consecutive tests, each stamped as it
completes. An observer can now tell a progressing run from a stalled one.

### On the run's overall conclusion

The workflow's conclusion was `failure`, and that does **not** weaken this
evidence. `Live External Integration` is an advisory/manual lane against real
Jira Data Center — it is not in the Gerrit `Verified` hot path, and the
`Verified +1` this change already carries came from the gating matrix. The
criterion asks whether the pytest step emits more than one distinct timestamp,
and the step emitted 238 regardless of how its assertions landed. A failing
assertion inside a step whose log is now legible is precisely the situation
this ticket existed to make possible.

The remaining failure in that lane is external-integration behaviour against
live Jira DC and is not this ticket's subject; it is out of scope here rather
than silently absorbed.
